The results demonstrate that the additively manufactured FGM-1 sample exhibits a strong solid solution strengthening effect.

Grain boundary strengthening is accomplished by impeding dislocation slip, with the discontinuity of slip planes at grain boundaries and orientation changes between adjacent grains playing crucial roles in hindering dislocation movement.
